title: One woman we remember with love
intro: Today we remember one woman from Veneto. We share only what trusted sources have told us, and we hold her in our thoughts with gratitude.

women.name: Anna Maria Della Colletta
tribute: Anna Maria Della Colletta, 68, lived in Castello Roganzuolo, in the municipality of San Fior, in the province of Treviso. She is remembered as a woman devoted to her family and to her work.
